name: Deborah
summary: A prophetess who judged Israel under a palm tree in the hills of Ephraim. She called Barak to fight Sisera, went with him, and sang of the LORD's victory.

key_moments.title: Calls Barak to Fight Sisera
key_moments.description: Deborah told Barak the LORD had commanded him to gather ten thousand men at Mount Tabor. Barak would not go without her, so she went, but said the LORD would hand Sisera over to a woman.

key_moments.title: Sends Barak into Battle
key_moments.description: Deborah told Barak to rise up, for that day the LORD had given Sisera into his hand and was going out ahead of him.

key_moments.title: Sings of Israel's Victory
key_moments.description: Deborah and Barak sang praise to the LORD for Israel's victory. She sang that the villages lay empty until she rose up like a mother to Israel.
